transcript.answer: Lore's own Floor (apps/floor) was deleted on 2026-10-02. The deletion was PR #2431 (commit ca031776d). The external floor replaced it. That is the rewritten standalone Floor engine, re-cinq/floor, which runs in the same cluster as Lore. Lore reaches it only through `@re-cinq/floor-client`, configured with FLOOR_API_URL and FLOOR_SERVICE_TOKEN. ADR-049 describes the move, which went one family of assembly lines at a time. The old and new floors ran side by side until the last line had moved. The code-review lines now run on the external floor as floor pipeline YAML files under libs/assembly-lines/src/floor-pipelines/.
